preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 100,000.
The adjacency list adj must have a length equal to the number of vertices V.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: Each element in the adjacency list adj must be a list of neighbors.

postconditions.description: The output must be a sorted list of articulation points.

postconditions.expression: len(articulationPoints(V, adj)) == 0 or all(0 <= point < V for point in articulationPoints(V, adj))
postconditions.description: All articulation points must be valid vertex indices within the range of 0 to V-1.

postconditions.expression: len(articulationPoints(V, adj)) == 0 or len(set(articulationPoints(V, adj))) == len(articulationPoints(V, adj))
postconditions.description: The list of articulation points must not contain duplicate vertices.
